description: Guarded factual field filling for inspected BJAK optional-visa form only. Does not submit. Stops for new mandatory questions or required visa. Requires deduplication and role review first.
source: (async function(tab,id,note){const h=eval(load('helpers'));const s=await h.inspect(tab);const a={...load('bjakBaseAnswers')};a['795f64cf-c23a-42e8-8f0b-b7191ea0ad3a']=note;const allowed=new Set([...Object.keys(a),'_systemfield_resume','e44c00b3-feb7-42d1-a87b-b7cf09659e1f']);if(s.labels.some(l=>l.html.includes('_required')&&!allowed.has(l.for)))throw Error('Changed required questions');if(s.labels.find(l=>l.for==='fa43f729-9d1f-44bc-8807-7af9c2117cdd')?.html.includes('_required'))throw Error('Required visa unknown');const uploaded=await h.upload(tab,id);await h.save('job-search/applications/'+id+'/upload-verification.json',uploaded);await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1400));await tools.mcp__t3_code__preview_open({tabId:tab,open:true,show:true});await h.fill(tab,a);const consent=await h.ev(tab,"(()=>{const e=document.querySelector('input[id$=\"labeled-checkbox-0\"]');if(!e)throw Error('Missing consent');if(!e.checked)e.click();return e.checked})()");if(!consent)throw Error('Consent not saved');await h.save('job-search/applications/'+id+'/answers.json',a);await h.save('job-search/applications/'+id+'/final-form-state-connected.json',await h.inspect(tab));return {tab,id,uploaded};})
